title: Abstraction in Java core-library classes
answer: Core Java uses abstraction through both interfaces and abstract classes. InputStream defines the idea of reading bytes while subclasses such as ByteArrayInputStream provide a source-specific implementation; collections similarly use interfaces such as List and Map. Client code therefore depends on a stable operation while concrete storage or I/O mechanics remain hidden.
